import math

# Constants
R_E = 6378.137  # km
mu = 398600.4418  # km^3/s^2

# Orbital radii
r1 = R_E + 300.0      # initial circular orbit (300 km altitude)
r2 = R_E + 35786.0    # GEO orbit (35,786 km altitude)

print(f"Initial orbit radius r1 = {r1:.4f} km")
print(f"GEO orbit radius r2 = {r2:.4f} km")
print()

# --- Hohmann transfer calculations ---

# Semi-major axis of transfer ellipse
a_t = (r1 + r2) / 2.0
print(f"Transfer orbit semi-major axis a_t = {a_t:.4f} km")

# 1. Initial orbital velocity (circular at r1)
v1 = math.sqrt(mu / r1)
print(f"\n1. Initial orbital velocity v1 = sqrt(mu/r1) = {v1:.6f} km/s")

# 2. Transfer-orbit velocity at perigee (r1)
v_p = math.sqrt(mu * (2.0/r1 - 1.0/a_t))
print(f"2. Transfer velocity at perigee v_p = sqrt(mu*(2/r1 - 1/a_t)) = {v_p:.6f} km/s")

# 3. First burn delta-v
delta_v1 = v_p - v1
print(f"3. First burn delta-v = v_p - v1 = {delta_v1:.6f} km/s")

# 4. Transfer velocity at apogee (r2)
v_a = math.sqrt(mu * (2.0/r2 - 1.0/a_t))
print(f"4. Transfer velocity at apogee v_a = sqrt(mu*(2/r2 - 1/a_t)) = {v_a:.6f} km/s")

# 5. GEO circular velocity
v_GEO = math.sqrt(mu / r2)
print(f"5. GEO circular velocity v_GEO = sqrt(mu/r2) = {v_GEO:.6f} km/s")

# 6. Second burn delta-v
delta_v2 = v_GEO - v_a
print(f"6. Second burn delta-v = v_GEO - v_a = {delta_v2:.6f} km/s")

# 7. Total delta-v
delta_v_total = delta_v1 + delta_v2
print(f"\n7. Total delta-v = {delta_v_total:.6f} km/s")

# 8. Transfer time
T_t = 2.0 * math.pi * math.sqrt(a_t**3 / mu)
print(f"\n8. Transfer time T_t = 2*pi*sqrt(a_t^3/mu) = {T_t:.6f} s")
print(f"   = {T_t/3600:.6f} hours")
print(f"   = {T_t/86400:.6f} days")

# --- Sanity check with vis-viva equation ---
# For the initial circular orbit: vis-viva at r1 with circular velocity
# v1_visiva = sqrt(mu*(2/r1 - 1/r1)) = sqrt(mu/r1) — same as circular velocity
v1_check = math.sqrt(mu * (2.0/r1 - 1.0/r1))
print(f"\n--- Sanity check (vis-viva at r1) ---")
print(f"v1 via vis-viva = sqrt(mu*(2/r1 - 1/r1)) = {v1_check:.6f} km/s")
print(f"Match: {abs(v1 - v1_check) < 1e-10}")

# For transfer orbit at perigee: vis-viva at r1
v_p_check = math.sqrt(mu * (2.0/r1 - 1.0/a_t))
print(f"v_p via vis-viva = sqrt(mu*(2/r1 - 1/a_t)) = {v_p_check:.6f} km/s")
print(f"Match: {abs(v_p - v_p_check) < 1e-10}")

# For transfer orbit at apogee: vis-viva at r2
v_a_check = math.sqrt(mu * (2.0/r2 - 1.0/a_t))
print(f"v_a via vis-viva = sqrt(mu*(2/r2 - 1/a_t)) = {v_a_check:.6f} km/s")
print(f"Match: {abs(v_a - v_a_check) < 1e-10}")

# GEO circular via vis-viva
v_GEO_check = math.sqrt(mu * (2.0/r2 - 1.0/r2))
print(f"v_GEO via vis-viva = sqrt(mu*(2/r2 - 1/r2)) = {v_GEO_check:.6f} km/s")
print(f"Match: {abs(v_GEO - v_GEO_check) < 1e-10}")

# Print to 3 significant figures
print("\n=== Results to 3 significant figures ===")
print(f"v1 = {v1:.3g} km/s")
print(f"v_p = {v_p:.3g} km/s")
print(f"delta_v1 = {delta_v1:.3g} km/s")
print(f"v_a = {v_a:.3g} km/s")
print(f"v_GEO = {v_GEO:.3g} km/s")
print(f"delta_v2 = {delta_v2:.3g} km/s")
print(f"delta_v_total = {delta_v_total:.3g} km/s")
print(f"T_t = {T_t:.3g} s")

print(f"4. Transfer velocity at apogee v_a = sqrt(mu*(2/r2 - 1/a_t)) = {v_a:.6f} km/s")

# 5. GEO circular velocity
v_GEO = math.sqrt(mu / r2)
print(f"5. GEO circular velocity v_GEO = sqrt(mu/r2) = {v_GEO:.6f} km/s")

# 6. Second burn delta-v
delta_v2 = v_GEO - v_a
print(f"6. Second burn delta-v = v_GEO - v_a = {delta_v2:.6f} km/s")

# 7. Total delta-v
delta_v_total = delta_v1 + delta_v2
print(f"\n7. Total delta-v = {delta_v_total:.6f} km/s")

# 8. Transfer time

print(f"   = {T_t/86400:.6f} days")

# For transfer orbit at perigee: vis-viva at r1
v_p_check = math.sqrt(mu * (2.0/r1 - 1.0/a_t))

# For transfer orbit at apogee: vis-viva at r2
v_a_check = math.sqrt(mu * (2.0/r2 - 1.0/a_t))

# GEO circular via vis-viva
v_GEO_check = math.sqrt(mu * (2.0/r2 - 1.0/r2))
print(f"v_GEO via vis-viva = sqrt(mu*(2/r2 - 1/r2)) = {v_GEO_check:.6f} km/s")
print(f"Match: {abs(v_GEO - v_GEO_check) < 1e-10}")

# Print to 3 significant figures

print(f"T_t = {T_t:.3g} s")
